title: Dictionary Entries
description: Look at the dictionary entries below. Use the information provided to complete the sentences.

entries.definition: a broadcast on television or radio
bullet_points: Families often sit together on the sofa to [watch a programme] in the evening.
She turns on the television right at seven to catch her [favourite programme].
The weekly magazine contains a detailed [programme schedule] for all channels.
Many morning commuters [listen to a programme] on their car radio.

questions.text: After dinner, the children usually gather around the TV screen to __________ about wild animals.
Our school newspaper prints the daily __________ so students can plan their viewing time.

entries.definition: a person or an animal represented in a film, play, or story
bullet_points: Children love the funny yellow sponge [cartoon character] living under the ocean.
Costume fans like to [dress as a character] from popular fantasy comics.
Novelists spend months thinking of interesting traits to [create a character].
The brave young princess is the [main character] of this animated story.

questions.text: Art students learn how to sketch expressive faces to __________ for their comic books.
In this adventure tale, the clever detective is the __________ who discovers the missing treasure.

entries.definition: a television station and its broadcast programmes
bullet_points: Viewers can find many high-quality cooking lessons [on this channel].
Please check the [channel number] in the guide before entering it on the remote.
My uncle subscribes to a dedicated [sports channel] for weekend matches.
Press the red button on the remote to [change the channel] quickly.

questions.text: Football fans always tune into the popular __________ to follow live tennis and athletic tournaments.
If you do not like this boring news broadcast, you can use the remote control to __________.

bullet_points: Colourful animations are designed specifically to entertain [young viewers].
Humorous jokes and bright costumes help the comedy [appeal to viewers].
High [viewer ratings] show that the singing contest is very successful.
Action movies usually [attract viewers] with exciting special effects.

questions.text: The educational broadcast uses cheerful animal songs so that __________ can easily remember English words.
Clever quiz questions and generous cash prizes help the game show __________ from all over the country.

entries.definition: a film, play, or show with humorous characters and a happy ending
bullet_points: That weekly [comedy series] has six episodes full of funny school situations.
Amateur comedians perform their funniest stand-up jokes at the downtown [comedy club].
People gather in the living room to [enjoy a comedy] after a long workday.
Couples often choose a lighthearted [romantic comedy] for date night at the cinema.

questions.text: Tired workers like to sit back on the couch and __________ to forget their daily stress.
The television network is airing a delightful new __________ about the adventures of four college roommates.
